name: prospecting
description: B2B lead discovery and enrichment. Define your ideal customer profile (ICP), find matching contacts at scale, enrich a name into verified email and phone, generate target lists from your buy box or ICP, and hand off qualified prospects directly into your CRM pipeline. Provider-agnostic — works with Apollo, Hunter, Lusha, ZoomInfo, or Vibe Prospecting MCPs if installed, with web-search fallback when no provider is configured.
